  have h : ∀ (m : Nat), f m = f 0 := by

theorem const_of_strongRec (f : Nat → α) {c : Nat}
    (hcon : ∀ {n : Nat}, c ≤ n → f (n + 1) = f n) {n : Nat} (hle : c ≤ n) : f n = f c := by
  have h : ∀ (k : Nat), f (c + k) = f c := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      have h₁ : c ≤ c + k := Nat.le_add_right c k
      have h₂ : f (c + k + 1) = f (c + k) := hcon (n := c + k) (by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using h₁)
      rw [Nat.add_assoc] at *
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using h₂.trans ih
  have h₁ : f n = f c := by
    have h₂ : f (c + (n - c)) = f c := h (n - c)
    have h₃ : c + (n - c) = n := by
      have h₄ : c ≤ n := hle
      omega
    rw [h₃] at h₂
    exact h₂
  exact h₁

end Sequence

namespace List

@[simp] theorem isPrefixOf_iff_IsPrefix [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    isPrefixOf l₁ l₂ ↔ l₁ <+: l₂ := by
  match l₁, l₂ with
  | [],   _  => simp [nil_prefix]
  | _::_, [] => simp
  | a::as, b::bs =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      simp only [isPrefixOf, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
      let ⟨t, ht⟩ := isPrefixOf_iff_IsPrefix.mp h.2
      exists t
      simpa [h.1]
    · intro ⟨t, ht⟩
      simp only [cons_append, cons.injEq] at ht
      have hpf : as <+: bs := ⟨t, ht.2⟩
      simpa [isPrefixOf, ht.1] using isPrefixOf_iff_IsPrefix.mpr hpf

@[simp] theorem isSuffixOf_iff_IsSuffix [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    isSuffixOf l₁ l₂ ↔ l₁ <:+ l₂ := by
  match l₁, l₂ with
  | [],   _  => simp [nil_suffix, isSuffixOf]
  | _::_, [] => simp [isSuffixOf, isPrefixOf]
  | a::as, b::bs =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      simp only [isSuffixOf, reverse_cons] at h
      let ⟨t, ht⟩ := isPrefixOf_iff_IsPrefix.mp h
      exists t.reverse
      simpa using congrArg reverse ht
    · intro ⟨t, ht⟩
      have hpf : (as.reverse ++ [a]) <+: (bs.reverse ++ [b]) := by
        exists t.reverse
        simpa using congrArg reverse ht
      simpa [isSuffixOf, reverse_cons] using isPrefixOf_iff_IsPrefix.mpr hpf

end List

-- this code is written in Lean v4.28.0

import Mathlib.Data.Set.Basic

namespace Set

open Function

universe u

theorem ext' {α : Type u} {A B : Set α} (h : ∃ (f : {x // x ∈ A} → {x // x ∈ B}),
    Surjective f ∧ ∀ (a : {x // x ∈ A}), ∃ (haB : a.val ∈ B), f a = ⟨a.val, haB⟩) : A = B := by
  -- Unpack the existential hypothesis
  rcases h with ⟨f, surj_f, hf_eq⟩

  -- We need to show A = B, which means ∀ x, x ∈ A ↔ x ∈ B
  ext x
  constructor

  -- First direction: if x ∈ A, then x ∈ B
  · intro hxA
    -- Consider the element ⟨x, hxA⟩ : {x // x ∈ A}
    let a : {x // x ∈ A} := ⟨x, hxA⟩
    -- By hf_eq, f a = ⟨a.val, haB⟩ for some haB : a.val ∈ B
    rcases hf_eq a with ⟨haB, hf_a_eq⟩
    -- hf_a_eq tells us f a = ⟨a.val, haB⟩, but a.val = x
    -- So we have haB : x ∈ B
    exact haB

  -- Second direction: if x ∈ B, then x ∈ A
  · intro hxB
    -- Since f is surjective, there exists some a : {x // x ∈ A} such that f a = ⟨x, hxB⟩
    rcases surj_f ⟨x, hxB⟩ with ⟨a, ha_eq⟩
    -- ha_eq: f a = ⟨x, hxB⟩
    -- By hf_eq, f a = ⟨a.val, haB⟩ for some haB : a.val ∈ B
    rcases hf_eq a with ⟨haB, hf_a_eq⟩
    -- So we have f a = ⟨a.val, haB⟩ and f a = ⟨x, hxB⟩
    -- Therefore ⟨a.val, haB⟩ = ⟨x, hxB⟩, which means a.val = x (by Subtype.ext)
    -- From ha_eq: f a = ⟨x, hxB⟩ and from hf_a_eq: f a = ⟨a.val, haB⟩
    -- So ⟨x, hxB⟩ = ⟨a.val, haB⟩, which means x = a.val
    rw [hf_a_eq] at ha_eq
    -- Now ha_eq is ⟨a.val, haB⟩ = ⟨x, hxB⟩
    -- This means a.val = x (by definition of subtype equality)
    have a_val_eq_x : a.val = x := by
      cases ha_eq
      rfl
    -- So a = ⟨x, haB⟩, which means x ∈ A
    exact Eq.subst a_val_eq_x a.property

theorem ext_iff' {α : Type u} {A B : Set α} : A = B ↔ ∃ (f : {x // x ∈ A} → {x // x ∈ B}), Surjective f ∧
    ∀ (x : {x // x ∈ A}), ∃ (hxB : x.val ∈ B), f x = ⟨x.val, hxB⟩ := by
  constructor

  -- First direction: A = B implies the existence of such a function
  · intro hAB
    -- Since A = B, we can use the identity function
    let f (a : {x // x ∈ A}) : {x // x ∈ B} := ⟨a.val, hAB ▸ a.property⟩
    use f
    constructor

    -- Show f is surjective
    · intro b
      -- Since A = B, b.val ∈ A
      have hbA : b.val ∈ A := hAB ▸ b.property
      -- So ⟨b.val, hbA⟩ : {x // x ∈ A}
      let a : {x // x ∈ A} := ⟨b.val, hbA⟩
      -- Show f a = b
      have f_a_eq_b : f a = b := by
        ext
        rfl
      exact ⟨a, f_a_eq_b⟩

    -- Show the property holds for all a
    · intro a
      -- f a = ⟨a.val, hAB ▸ a.property⟩
      -- We need to show this equals ⟨a.val, hxB⟩ for some hxB : a.val ∈ B
      use hAB ▸ a.property

  -- Second direction: the existence of such a function implies A = B
  · exact ext'

end Set
